c153528230.notes: Roadside farm-stall board at Wilhelmstal (B2). 'PAD' and 'STAL' are split either side of an oryx-head logo. Keep the diaeresis in 'DROËWORS'. The blue bottom strip ('TOLL FREE 924', 'E-MED RESCUE 24 CHOOSE LIFE') is an advert distractor; vehicles behind the fence are incidental.

c70649643.notes: Painted name plate in an uncial-style font on a yellow wall, Swakopmund. The blue relief plaque at left ('Erbaut im Jahre 1913', blackletter) is a distractor.

c178874834.notes: White river-name sign with a blue wavy-water pictogram beside the road east of Wilhelmstal; mid-distance (about 170 px wide). It marks the Okasise river crossing.

c53533102.notes: Two brown tourist direction signs (guest farms) with house, hiking and cave pictograms and right-turn arrows, on the B1 north of Otavi. 'CAVES' is a tiny label over the cave icon. Alternative query: 'Ghaub'.

c79509140.notes: Old German enamel street plate with rusted edges, Swakopmund. The map may list the street as 'Bismarck Street' or 'Bismarckstraße'; the sign itself reads 'Bismarck-Str.'.

c113921182.notes: English/German office-hours plate of a Namibia Wildlife Resorts office. 'NWR' is a stylised script logo. Spellings are as printed: 'BUROSTUNDEN' without umlaut and 'SONNENUTERGANG' (missing n). The dashes between times are square dots on the sign. Glare across the right of the lower lines.

c125797042.notes: Pylon sign seen from below, Swakopmund: script 'Altstadt Restaurant' over a round logo ('EST. 2018' tiny), with two street-name light boxes ('HENDRIK WITBOOI', 'ANTON LUBOWSKI') on the same pole. The phone number is cut off behind the street box ('PHONE - 064 4...'). Alternative queries: 'Hendrik Witbooi' or 'Anton Lubowski' (street).

c126091609.notes: Large brown tourist direction sign in Windhoek, seen from below, with museum/theatre/monument pictograms; the top five destinations go left, the bottom three right. A woman seen from behind is incidental. Alternative query: 'Alte Feste'.

c19557031.reason: schoolyard with flag; no legible sign

c53314699.reason: museum information board listing cannons (English/German); the title line is cut off at the top

c69841757.reason: generic 'WELKOM' farm gate sign; no name

c71217869.notes: White street blade seen from below, Windhoek; the edge of a perpendicular blade crosses the 'F' between 'BAHNHO' and 'STRASSE'. The street is usually mapped as 'Bahnhof Street'. The cross street blade (text edge-on, ending '...VENUE'?) is not legible.

c19557035.notes: Painted lettering on the gate wall, Drimiopsis. The second line is in a brush-script font where the two 'l's are lowercase loop letters among capitals ('TlHABANEllO' = Tlhabanello); they could be misread as 'I'. The school crest at left and the 'AIDS KILLS / TAKE CONTROL' ribbon mural on the right wall are distractors.

c11894401.notes: White fascia over a store veranda in Asab, southern Namibia. Product logos (JOKO, MILK) on the fascia, MTC 'mtc make the connection' wall panels, a 'TAKE AWAY' sign and small posters are distractors.

c74341273.notes: Green park rules board at the roadside. Only the park name and heading are targets; the warning pictograms, '100' speed-limit roundel, captions ('STRICTLY NO OFF-ROAD DRIVING', 'ADHERE TO THE SPEED LIMIT', 'IT IS ILLEGAL TO REMOVE PLANTS / ANIMALS', 'KEEP OUR PARK CLEAN - BRING OUT WHAT YOU TAKE IN', 'PLEASE REPORT ANY VIOLATIONS TO (064) 205 726') and the tiny sponsor line are secondary.
